plugins.cameraPermission: FleetTms uses the camera to photograph the odometer, cargo and any faults.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: FleetTms stamps each photo with where it was taken, and shows your employer where the lorry is during a trip.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: FleetTms shares the lorry's position with your employer while a trip is running, including with the screen off. It stops when you end the trip.
